title.en: Renewing and consuming as a relation to participated conditions
title.zh: 参与关系中的更新与消耗：关系性分类

claim.en: A formation is renewing when every condition it depends on or draws on keeps supporting each formation that depends on that condition, and consuming when it draws on a condition some dependent formation permanently loses. Over arbitrary unfoldings the classes are exclusive and not exhaustive, and unrenewed drawdown admits finitely many active steps. When the condition is renewed by a formation that depends on it, drawing beyond renewal permanently ends that renewal: a dependent focal formation then ends itself with bounded formation, while an independent one can persist and form without bound. Forming new organization at every active step does not decide the class, nor does the focal formation's own activity and formation over the whole unfolding. Joint drawing can consume when each party alone is within renewal, and escalation that begins within renewal can consume. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.
claim.zh: 一项形成若使它依存或取用的每个条件都持续支持依存于该条件的每项形成，则为更新型；若它取用的某个条件使某个依存者永久失去支持，则为消耗型。在任意展开上两类互斥而不穷尽；无更新的取用只容许有限次发生。条件若由依存于它的形成更新，超出更新的取用会永久终止这一更新：依存于该条件的焦点形成随之终止自身、形成量有界，不依存的焦点形成则可以持续并无界形成。每次发生都形成新组织不能决定分类，焦点形成在整个展开中的自身发生与形成轨迹也不能。各方单独都在更新之内时，共同取用仍可消耗；起初在更新之内的升级也可消耗。不使用任何规范前提或 Lean 公理。

hypotheses.en: General part: definitions only. An unfolding supplies condition levels, activity, dependence with support levels, and drawing; Dependent states that a formation is active only where supported.
hypotheses.zh: 一般部分只有定义：展开给出条件水平、发生、带支持水平的依存及取用；Dependent 表示形成只在受支持时发生。

hypotheses.en: Law family: one shared condition with natural-number levels; renewal is added while the condition supports the sustaining formation; the focal formation is active while supported (zero support level means independence) and contributes and draws stated amounts.
hypotheses.zh: 规律族：一个以自然数水平表示的共享条件；条件支持维持性形成时加入更新；焦点形成在受支持时发生（支持水平为零表示不依存），并按给定量贡献与取用。

hypotheses.en: Joint drawing is represented as one law with the summed draw, exact when the drawing formations share the same support level.
hypotheses.zh: 共同取用表示为取用相加的一条规律；当各取用者支持水平相同时这一表示是精确的。

correspondence.en: Formations, conditions and dependence are differentiated aspects of one unfolding, not owners exchanging resources. Readings of the law family as malignant growth, escalation or winning by consumption are interpretations; actual cases require evidence for their dependence, support levels and rates. `formed` counts units of new organization and is not a complexity measure.
correspondence.zh: 形成、条件与依存是同一展开中分化的方面，不是交换资源的所有者。把规律族读作恶性增长、升级竞赛或以消耗取胜属于解释；实际案例须为其依存、支持水平与速率取得证据。`formed` 计数新组织单位，不是复杂度量。

detail.en: Narrower law-class result proved independently the same day: under a supplied wear law it bounds total formation by stock plus a triangular renewal budget, shows the local first-step reversal and gives a G0 event-reading interface. Here irreversibility is derived from the renewer's dependence rather than assumed, the classification is general, and externalizing consumption is covered. No import either way.
detail.zh: 同日独立证明的较窄规律类结果：在给定磨损规律下以所持条件加三角更新预算界定总形成量，给出第一步局部反转及 G0 逐事件接口。本结果的不可逆由更新者的依存推出而非假定，分类是一般的，并覆盖外部化消耗。互不导入。

detail.en: Interpretive: read with 生生 as its object, G0's positive ground does not attach to consuming formation; this result supplies that object descriptively, without an evaluative filter. Its proof is unchanged.
detail.zh: 解释关联：以生生为对象时，G0 的正面根据不附于消耗型形成；本结果以描述方式给出这一对象，不作价值筛选。其证明不变。

detail.en: Interpretive: a zero-axiom differentiation of generation and degeneration within one relational description; it does not complete the open foundational target.
detail.zh: 解释关联：在同一关系描述中以零公理区分生成与退化；不完成开放的根基目标。

detail.en: Interpretive: no_return_below_support gives one concrete mechanism of non-return; no formal composition with the endpoint theorem is claimed.
detail.zh: 解释关联：no_return_below_support 给出一种具体的不可返回机制；未声称与端点定理的形式组合。

detail.en: Consumer of this classification: imports RelationalRenewal and feeds overdraw_consuming into GenerativeComparison's C under the relational reading of G0's generation. This record's own claims and proofs are unchanged.
detail.zh: 本分类的使用者：导入 RelationalRenewal，在对 G0 之生成的关系读法下把 overdraw_consuming 送入 GenerativeComparison 的 C。本记录自身的主张与证明不变。

detail.en: own_trajectory_does_not_decide: identical own activity and formation at every step, opposite classes. Persistence, success or growth of a formation is not a criterion of renewal.
detail.zh: own_trajectory_does_not_decide：每一步自身发生与形成完全相同，分类相反。形成的持续、成功或增长都不是更新的判准。

detail.en: fluctuating_neither: support that recurs without lasting is neither renewing nor consuming; the classification is not a forced dichotomy, and cycle-level renewal is not yet defined.
detail.zh: fluctuating_neither：反复出现而不持续的支持既非更新型也非消耗型；分类不是强加的二分，周期层面的更新尚未定义。

detail.en: One shared condition in the law family, no substitution between conditions, attribution within joint consumption not formalized, and no ethical ranking in this module (with C and the relational reading, relational-reading-comparison ranks every overdraw of the law family below its absence; mixed cases stay unranked); finite fulfillment, rest and appropriate ending are not consumption.
detail.zh: 规律族只有一个共享条件，条件间替代未建模，共同消耗中的归因未形式化，本模块也没有伦理排序（在 C 与关系读法下，relational-reading-comparison 把规律族中每一种超额取用排在其不发生之下；混合情形仍未排序）；有限完成、休息与适当结束不是消耗。

limitations.en: Completes a descriptive classification and its dynamics within the stated representations. It does not show that real processes satisfy the law family, how losses within a renewed cycle are weighed, or that the zero-substantive-axiom foundation of Becoming is complete. Its ethical significance is not an addition owed beyond G0: G0's object is 生生, which this classification describes; the comparison of consumption with its absence under C is the separate record relational-reading-comparison.
limitations.zh: 完成的是所述表示中的描述性分类及其动力学。未证明真实过程满足规律族，未说明更新循环中的损失如何权衡，也未完成 Becoming 的零附加实质公理根基。其伦理意义不是 G0 之外另欠的工作：G0 的对象是生生，本分类描述的正是生生；消耗与其不发生在 C 下的比较，见另一记录 relational-reading-comparison。

validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 check passed: 35 theorems / 60 declaration audits, every axiom set empty (no propext, Quot.sound or Classical.choice); 4 compiled application examples. Eight theorems are arithmetic helpers proved locally to avoid axiom-dependent library lemmas. The shared receipt also checks RenewalComparison (credited to relational-reading-comparison). Author counterreview; no independent-agent review.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 检查通过：35项定理／60项声明审计，公理集全部为空（无 propext、Quot.sound 或 Classical.choice）；编译4个应用例。其中8项为本地证明的算术辅助引理，以避免依赖公理的库引理。同一回执也检查 RenewalComparison（计入 relational-reading-comparison）。作者反审，无独立 agent 审查。

next_delta.en: Define cycle-level renewal and substitution between conditions, and test whether the classification is preserved; formalize difference-making attribution within joint consumption; establish empirical correspondence for particular cases.
next_delta.zh: 定义周期层面的更新与条件间替代，检验分类是否保持；形式化共同消耗中的差异归因；为具体案例建立经验对应。

history.en: 9 October 2026: created following Ren's instruction to separate renewing from consuming formation by relational structure without any axiom, answering review §3.3. Registered separately from the narrower renewing-consuming-formation, with which it shares no import.
history.zh: 2026年10月9日：依 Ren“用关系结构把两种形成分开……不需要任何axiom”的指示新建，回应审查 §3.3。与较窄的 renewing-consuming-formation 分开登记，二者互不导入。
2026-10-09：核读新增有限修复解释及共享章中不可返回前提的明确化。仅更新所涉陈述／整合来源版本；原主张、证明与回执保持，正净修复不满足旧不可返回的前提。
history.en: 2026-10-09: Reviewed the added finite-repair explanation and explicit no-return premise in the shared chapter. Updates only affected statement/integration source versions; prior claims, proofs and receipts remain. Positive net repair does not satisfy the earlier no-return premise.

9 October 2026: after Ren's follow-up ('为什么？我G0是什么？generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧'), corrected the limitation and boundary wording that treated renewal's positive significance as owed beyond G0 and left consumption unranked; the ranking under C is the new relational-reading-comparison. The receipt now also covers that module; RelationalRenewal's source, claims and proofs are unchanged. Rehashed statement, integration, provenance and receipt after confirming the only changes were these edits.
history.zh: 2026年10月9日：依 Ren 追问（“为什么？我G0是什么？generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”），修正把更新的正面意义当作 G0 之外另欠、并把消耗留为未排序的限制与边界措辞；C 下的排序见新记录 relational-reading-comparison。回执现亦覆盖该模块；RelationalRenewal 的源码、主张与证明不变。确认变动仅为上述编辑后，更新陈述、整合、来源与回执哈希。
